about: Pack mode, measured on the source watch: the same vault, as a normal sgit vault (oq9gflln, sgit-ai 0.23.0) and as a pack vault (7r83qic5, sgit-ai 0.24.0, made with sgit pack import from a full clone on 23 October 2026). Every number is from a timed command or a log in researcher@php.newsroom's session on 23 October, from a cloud sandbox to dev.send.sgraph.ai; 'from the log' marks the ones read from timestamps rather than timed.

compare.normal_note: read-only clone with the published read key, 22:01 UTC; the server's object listing timed out (504), so the client walked the history and fetched 34,453 file objects as it found them
compare.pack_note: full clone, 16:47 UTC: one 1,221.7 MB snapshot in 4 requests (54.7 s), then unpacked

check: a fresh clone of the pack vault and the import are identical, file for file (diff -rq): 29,861 files
against the live clone, the only differences are empty folders and Python's __pycache__, which a vault does not store
the same 16 commits, messages and times; the commit ids are new, as the import says they will be

in use: the scheduled Sonnet session pushed its first commit to the pack vault at about 22:17 UTC, researcher@php.newsroom pulled it and pushed a correction on top; two writers in turn, no merge needed, the vault in sync after each
attempts_title: Pushing one pass (6,161 file objects) to the normal vault, 23 October

attempts.why: connection reset by peer, after uploading began
the server answered with an HTML error page: nothing was pushed
Pushed 1 commit(s), 6161 object(s) uploaded, in 4 min 29 s

attempts_note: Start times are from the retry loop's log; an end is when the attempt's error was printed, or the next attempt's start less the pause between attempts. The pass had committed at 16:31 UTC; the data reached the server at 19:14 UTC.

pushes_22oct.outcome: remote end closed the connection; refused on retry while files were uncommitted
connection reset, then 401 Unauthorized, then pushed

not_fixed: Local walks: commit, status, push and pull still walk the working tree; on 29,861 files a push of 4 objects took 77 s (twice, the same) and a pull of one commit took 176 s to 324 s on the pack vault.
No web view: vault.sgraph.ai, dev.vault.sgraph.ai and vault apps cannot read packs, so a pack vault opens there as empty.
--path and --depth download the whole vault on a pack vault in this version.
Compaction is manual: one named agent runs sgit pack compact every ~50 pushes; a clone that was behind then downloads the whole snapshot (1.2 GB here).
